# ssync_mapper_node (Resource)

The mapper_node records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String)
- `node_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `input` (Dynamic)
- `mapper_id` (String) The mapper the node is placed on, by its key
- `object_id` (String) The mapper object the node reads, by its key
- `position` (Dynamic) Where the node sits on the canvas
